@@U04591@@
Ah, how this clattering of spades delights me!
These gangs of men laboring for me here;
reconciling earth with earth,
setting boundaries to the waves,
confining the sea’s vast power!

@@U04593@@
(Aside, to the audience.)

@@U04594@@
And yet, who else have you toiled for but us,
with your dams and dikes, preparing a grand feast
for sea devil 涅普顿's pleasure?
Mankind hasn't a chance, do what it will.
It’s with us the elements are in league.
Annihilation is the law of Nature.

@@U04596@@
Overseer!

@@U04598@@
Here!

@@U04600@@
Use every means,
great gangs of men are needed,
do anything, persuade them,
pay them, treat them well,
drive them, use force, anything,
but I want daily a full report
on the progress of the ditch I’ve begun.

@@U04602@@
(In an undertone.)

@@U04603@@
According to my report,
it’s a grave has been ordered.

@@U04605@@
There is a marsh skirting the foot of those mountains
that poisons with its pestilence all I’ve accomplished.
If I could drain that pool, my final deed
would also be my greatest, for I would then
translation:
@@U04591@@
啊，黑桃的叮当声让我多么高兴啊！
这些人在这里为我工作；
使大地与大地和解，
为波浪设定界限，
禁锢大海的浩瀚力量！

@@U04593@@
（一边，对观众说。）

@@U04594@@
然而，除了我们，你还为谁辛苦劳作，
用你的水坝和堤坝，准备一场盛宴
为了海魔涅普顿的高兴？
人类没有机会，就尽力而为吧。
我们的元素是一致的。
湮灭是自然法则。

@@U04596@@
监督者！

@@U04598@@
在这里！

@@U04600@@
利用一切手段，
需要伟大的人帮，
做任何事，说服他们，
付钱给他们，善待他们，
驱赶他们，使用武力，任何事情，
但我想要每天一份完整的报告
关于我已经开始的沟渠的进展。

@@U04602@@
（低声说道。）

@@U04603@@
根据我的报告，
这是一个坟墓已经被订购了。

@@U04605@@
那些山脚下有一片沼泽
它用瘟疫毒害了我所取得的一切。
如果我能排干那个池子，我的最后一件事
